change: Tilted backed trace-data panel with a large retained-point count and the latest ten indexed coordinate rows
anchoring: Fixed beside the first retained sample when the panel first opens; remains fixed through capacity eviction; clear hides and resets it.
row_numbering: One-based indices into the current retained line, not lifetime sample IDs. Eighteen points display rows 9 through 18.
layout: Backing expands to measured glyph bounds, including configured font sizes and the time recorder extra line.

checks.scope: Real recorder with supplied positions; screenshot is one trace, not a headset reading test.

limits: Actual packed scenes and rendering with supplied motions; headset acceptance and simultaneous-panel crowding have not been tested. Startup UID/certificate/log/shader cache diagnostics persist without script errors.
